description: Qudit-ADAPT runs on the MWNP instances: 8 sizes x 2 pools (l=1,2) x 20 instances x 5 orderings. energy[k] is <H_C> after k operators (k=0 is the initial state |phi_g>), in the units of Eq. (33), whose ground-state energy is 0. Traces are truncated at 80 parameters; runs for n<=9 were computed with a cap of 150, and since ADAPT is deterministic their first 80 iterations are identical to a run with cap 80.
operator_format: each operator is a list of factors [site, axis], sites numbered from 1 in the order of numbers_per_qutrit; the generator is the Hermitian part (D + D^dagger)/2 of the product of angular-momentum factors, and the ansatz is exp(-i theta_k V_k) ... exp(-i theta_1 V_1) |phi_g>.
ordering_convention: ordering 0 is the ascending order of the numbers; orderings 1-4 are random permutations.
